Because `root>card` has `overflow: visible`, it does not clip its contents to its own bounding box. The evidence also shows the element’s border/content box ends at `y + height = 48px`, but with overflow visible, any text that extends past that bottom edge is still painted and can appear on the page outside the element. So a person could still read the last line even though it visually falls below `root>card`’s bottom edge.

ANSWER: YES
